title: [ingest] digestRejected drops superseded/duplicate/consolidated failures from the ledger
summary: The /learnings rejected[] digest excludes any failure whose note matches /supersed|duplicate|consolidat/i — those are replaced, not genuine dead ends. Verdict losers become {approach, reason, beatenBy, source:'verdict'}; surviving failures become source:'failure'. Lets the planner skip relitigating settled losses.
